props.name: filter
props.comment: Merged over the stored filter, like a list's permanent filter.

props.name: filterDefaultValues
props.comment: The stored filter when no params are stored.

props.name: limit
props.comment: Rows fetched when the cached page cannot serve. Default 1000.

props.name: linkType
props.comment: Which page the neighbour links point at. Default `"edit"`.

props.name: sort
props.comment: Sort used when no params are stored. Default `id ASC`.

props.name: storeKey
props.comment: KV namespace the list persisted its params under. `false` ignores them. Default: the resource name.
